title: Genesis 22:1–2 — The Akedah, the Binding of Isaac
summary: Heading “The Akedah / The Binding of Isaac” with the Hebrew העקדה spaced out in red, and Genesis 22:1-2 in English: God tests Abraham and tells him to take his only son Isaac to the land of Moriah to offer him as a burnt offering. God, Abraham, son, Isaac and Moriah are in colour; in “lo♥e” the v is a heart with a small 1 after it.

text.text: 1 Now it came about after these things, that God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” And he said, “Here am I.”
2 He said, “Take now your son, your only son, whom you lo♥e¹, Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I will tell you.”
